cards.answer: Jarvan IV is a fighter/tank with AD scaling and mainly physical damage. He engages by dashing to his flag to knock enemies up, then can trap enemies inside terrain with his ultimate.
cards.counterplay: Stay off the line between Jarvan and his flag, and preserve mobility for his arena.

cards.answer: Martial Cadence adds physical damage based on the target's current health to a basic attack. It cannot trigger again on the same target until a short delay has passed.
cards.counterplay: Avoid giving him free opening attacks during trades.

cards.answer: Dragon Strike deals physical damage in a line and temporarily reduces the armor of enemies hit. If it connects with his flag, Jarvan dashes to the flag and knocks up enemies around him and along his path.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the line between Jarvan and his flag; avoid extended trades while your armor is reduced.

citations.quote: Jarvan IV extends his lance in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and reducing their armor for a short time.

cards.answer: Golden Aegis slows nearby enemies and shields Jarvan. The shield grows stronger when he hits more enemy champions.
cards.counterplay: Spread out around him and avoid committing damage into his shield.

cards.answer: Demacian Standard passively grants Jarvan attack speed. Casting it plants a flag that deals magic damage on impact, grants sight around it, and gives nearby Jarvan and allied champions bonus attack speed. The flag also provides the destination for his Dragon Strike dash.
cards.counterplay: Avoid fighting near his flag and approach the area cautiously.

cards.answer: Cataclysm leaps to an enemy champion's location, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies on arrival and creating a temporary ring of impassable terrain. Jarvan has displacement immunity during the leap and can recast to remove the terrain. A spell shield blocks the damage but does not prevent the terrain.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from threatened allies and save terrain-crossing mobility for the arena.
